ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Backup Deleted Via Wbadmin.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the deletion of backups or system state backups via "wbadmin.exe".
This technique is used by numerous ransomware families and actors.
This may only be successful on server platforms that have Windows Backup enabled.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\wbadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "WBADMIN\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*delete\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*backup.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*keepVersions\\:0.*"))
